chunks.title: PO Excess Procurement
chunks.heading: PO Excess Procurement
chunks.text:
• Currently PO excess approver “Order Access Procurement Approval” logic treat inquiry order procurement in it which we require to be excluded while validating excess procurement qty. The simple reason is inquiry orders gets spitted into confirmed orders and procurements already started against inquiry orders. So at one point of time, inquiry order indent line will be 0 and all the revision of PO/Creation will lead to excess procurement approval unnecessarily although at Main OC level / Style level it is within control.
• If Summary OC’s DCPO are changing the Qty and summary oc qty is same in that case it should not go for excess procurement approval.
For eg.
• Inquiry Order = 200
• Indent Generated
• RMPO created against Indent
• GRN Created
• Later, a Summary Order (OC) is received → split into Summary OCs (total still = 200)
• So:
• Inquiry Order = 0
• Summary Order = 200
• Indent Revised
• During RMPO revision, system shows Excess Qty and asks for approval —
But this is wrong because the required quantity hasn’t changed.
Ex- MTX-002073-001 on Metrex Test

chunks.title: Auto material allocation is processing only in case of OC split which should work on Main OC level
chunks.heading: Auto material allocation is processing only in case of OC split which should work on Main OC level
chunks.text: • Currently, the Auto Material Allocation works only during OC splitting. As per our requirement, it should function at the Main OC level as well. This means that when a new Summary OC is added manually, the system should still apply auto-allocation. During MRL generation, the newly added Summary OC line should also be auto-allocated if excess quantity is available on other lines, or if any inquiry/confirmed order quantity is reduced.
chunks.locator: § Auto material allocation is processing only in case of OC split which should work on Main OC level
